acceptance_criteria: The camera is requested only after a tap on the capture path, never on the board path; no frame or video is stored or sent; denied or missing camera gives a German message and a way back

The tracker (tasks-vision 0.10.35) and its models are served from the app's own origin in a cache separate from the board's pre-cache; a failed tracker download never breaks the board's install or start; the only CSP change is wasm-unsafe-eval; a check fails when the bundle names an external host
Landmark frames have equal scale on both axes and left means the child's own left hand; one- and two-hand frames are produced

A real-browser test in CI plays DGS videos from main_old as the fake camera through the app's own capture code, teaches each word from some videos and attempts it from others, and prints top-1, wrong-concept and unknown rates for one-hand and two-hand signs separately; no threshold is lowered
The DGS videos are read from the main_old history at test time and are not added to the main branch
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: A tap starts the camera, a worker runs the pinned hand tracker on each frame and the app gets landmark frames in the matcher's input contract; a real-browser test feeds DGS sign videos from main_old in as the camera and shows that signs taught from some videos are recognised from other videos of the same word.
